item.title: Missile Attack Kills at Least 3 in West Bank
item.summary: Several others were injured in the Iranian attack that was the first to kill Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank since the war began. Residents in Tehran and elsewhere in Iran describe lives gripped by fear and anger.

item.title: A Lebanese Cafe on the Edge of Destruction
item.summary: Near the center of Beirut, one image captures the aftermath of an Israeli strike.

item.title: For U.S., Unmet Expectations in Iran Fit a Familiar Pattern in the Region
item.summary: Iran’s military retaliation, along with the political defiance of its new leaders, evokes a decades-old pattern of unrealized goals for American interventions in the region.

item.title: Netanyahu Hopes Strikes on Iran Will Lead to Uprising and Regime Change
item.summary: Israeli attacks have targeted the command centers of Iran’s repressive, internal security forces in hopes that Iranians will overthrow their rulers. Some see that as wishful thinking.

item.title: As Iran War Drags On, Europe Wants to Avoid a New Migration Crisis
item.summary: A decade ago, a surge in migration to Europe spurred the far-right’s rise. European leaders now fear the Iran war could set off another crisis, and they have taken tentative steps to prepare.

item.title: Oil Prices Keep Climbing on Heightened Fears Over Energy Supplies
item.summary: Attacks on major energy facilities in Iran and Qatar injected new uncertainty into the outlook for oil and gas prices.

item.title: The Iran War’s Economic Threat to Europe and Asia
item.summary: Inflation and its consequences for growth is a growing concern for countries where memories of the 2022 energy crisis are fresh.

item.title: Iranian Missile Attack Leaves 3 Palestinians Dead in West Bank
item.summary: Several others were injured in the strike, which hit a caravan being used as a hair salon in the town of Beit Awwa, according to Palestinian officials.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Wednesday
item.summary: A day of strikes on energy facilities and testimony in Washington to members of Congress.

item.title: Pakistan Pauses Afghanistan Airstrikes for Eid
item.summary: At least 143 people were killed in a Pakistani airstrike that hit a drug rehabilitation facility in Kabul on Monday, according to a top U.N. official.
